text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An orientation for Tracen Academy's newly 
introduced support AI, the "Mega Dream 
Supporter," was scheduled to take place on 
this day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the guidance of the Three Goddesses, 
an explanation is given that the physical 
strain and resulting fatigue experienced 
in VR are no different from reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what they'd heard so far, it wasn't 
much different from the simulators 
originally installed at Tracen Academy, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every year, at the turning point of the 
season, they are notified of a "Special 
Race" in which only Umamusume chosen by 
the Three Goddesses may compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Junior-tier "Grow Up Race," the 
Classic-tier "WBC," and the Senior-tier 
"SWBC"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And waiting as opponents in the final race 
prepared for you, the Grand Masters, are 
none other than the Three Goddesses 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Based on vast amounts of Umamusume data, 
the running of the Three Goddesses—the 
pinnacle of running—inspires both the 
Trainer and Umamusume to rise to the 
challenge!
